baseline.scope: current backend src, with experiment adapters separately frozen

outcome.product: Improve current QQ Assistant memory and context behavior through complete live new-primary evaluation, independent review, causal diagnosis, justified architecture changes and repeat comparisons.
outcome.completion: Meet the frozen new-primary quality contract, preserve counterexamples and complete legacy regression comparisons. Do not equate executed runs, structural checks or a finite visible corpus with universal quality.
outcome.not_required: A rewrite or JEV adoption if comparative evidence does not justify it; real romantic outcomes.

authorization.source: Latest user requests: complete tests and iterative causal architecture improvement; current new datasets are primary, previous cases are regression; no global HTTP limit.
forbidden: production QQ or settings changes without separately applicable authorization
private records or credentials in Git/research archives
lowering criteria to rescue a candidate

execution.http_cap_scope: experiment total; per-request deadlines and product retry rules remain declared separately

regression.purpose: old cases protect against regressions; not the primary optimization target

e2e.other_allowed_grade: minor_edit only; no unresolved rewrite or insufficient_evidence

component.judge_basis: original evidence and common semantic contract, not provisional reference label matching

quality_contract.speed_claim: Only after same-input timed comparisons; JEV local speed does not establish end-to-end benefit.
quality_contract.references: AI references remain provisional; preserve independent disagreements and calibration.

evidence.sut: each implementation builds its own memory/context from original events; controlled component candidates are a separate setting
evidence.blinding: complete inline packet; hide implementation paths, preferred verdicts, hypothesis and provisional label references
evidence.lifecycle: backend synthetic QQ boundary != desktop; sequential stream != concurrent ingress or restart persistence
evidence.frozen_inputs: raw events, cutoffs, goals, controls, time policy, rubric/semantic contract, model settings, implementation and adapter
evidence.pre_implementation_data_review: Independent raw-data review complete; reviewer-only wording clarified before freeze without runtime changes; goals/context-memory-evaluation-20261105/versions/initial-primary remains immutable.

note_ingestion.new_stream: Normal authored material notes must traverse authenticated /api/note with product clock, scope and returned persisted identity; no direct Store writes in the new primary stream.
note_ingestion.legacy_regression: Historical note restoration remains an explicitly controlled archive boundary, with original dates and evidence links; it is not natural historical ingestion.
note_ingestion.old_runs: Observer-v3/v4 runs are preserved diagnostic evidence. New note-provenance comparisons use matched observer-v5 conditions on both arms.
note_ingestion.no_semantic_seeding: Raw author/channel/use information is not expected memory or a derived understanding.

iteration_policy.before_changes: complete baseline actual-output review and diagnose first supported cause; freeze targets plus paired countercases
iteration_policy.after_changes: functional checks, same-input live comparisons, independent blind review, expand according to shared impact
iteration_policy.thrash: when same failure recurs, change causal hypothesis instead of accumulating phrase-specific patches
iteration_policy.no_shortcuts: do not shorten a retained hard case, inject expected memory, edit old evidence or replace failing tasks

stages.objective: Current new empty-start E2E primary set
Current new controlled evidence-relation primary set
Pre-change independently reviewed new memory/context challenges
